title: TinTinBridge
tagline: Seamlessly connect and send tokens across chains! Easily swap Token A on Chain X for Token B on Chain Y (supported by CCTP: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, Solana, Optimism, Avalanche) with just one click and a smooth login. Your cross-chain adventure starts here!
description:
TinTin: Your Cross-Chain Crypto Companion

Overview:
TinTin is an innovative tool designed to revolutionize the way you interact with multiple blockchain networks and cryptocurrencies. It allows users to seamlessly connect and send tokens between different blockchain chains with unparalleled ease and security. With TinTin, you can effortlessly swap Token A on Chain X for Token B on Chain Y, all with a single click and a hassle-free login process.

Key Features:

Seamless Cross-Chain Transfers:
TinTin leverages the Cross Chain Transfer Protocol (CCTP) from Circle to facilitate smooth and efficient transfers of tokens across multiple chains. Supported chains include Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, Solana, Optimism, and Avalanche.

One-Click Swaps:
Integrated with 1Inch, TinTin provides users with the best possible swap rates, ensuring that your token exchanges are not only quick but also cost-effective. The one-click swap feature simplifies the process, making it accessible even for beginners.

Unified Wallet Connectivity:
TinTin supports Web3Auth, allowing users to connect various wallets and manage different coins on different chains effortlessly. Whether you prefer MetaMask, Phantom, or any other popular wallet, TinTin has got you covered.

User-Friendly Interface:
The intuitive and clean user interface of TinTin ensures that even those new to the world of cryptocurrency can navigate and use the platform with ease. Our goal is to make cross-chain interactions as simple as possible for everyone.

Secure and Reliable:
Security is paramount in the world of crypto. TinTin employs robust security measures to protect your assets and transactions, giving you peace of mind as you navigate the blockchain universe.

How It Works:

Login:
Use Web3Auth to log in to TinTin with your preferred wallet. The process is straightforward, ensuring a quick and secure login experience.

Select Tokens and Chains:
Choose the token you wish to send (Token A) and the chain it resides on (Chain X). Then, select the token you wish to receive (Token B) and the destination chain (Chain Y).

Execute Swap:
With just one click, execute the swap. TinTin handles the complex behind-the-scenes processes, ensuring your tokens are exchanged efficiently and securely.

Confirmation:
Receive confirmation of your completed transaction. Your new tokens will be available in your chosen wallet on the specified chain.

Why TinTin?
TinTin is designed for those who seek a seamless, efficient, and user-friendly solution for managing and transferring tokens across multiple blockchain networks. Whether you are a seasoned crypto enthusiast or a newcomer, TinTin offers the tools and features you need to navigate the decentralized world with confidence and ease.

Embark on your cross-chain adventure with TinTin today!
how_its_made:
Technology Stack:

Frontend:

Vue.js & Quasar.js: Efficient development and rich UI components for a responsive design.
Web3Auth: Provides secure, seamless wallet login.
TypeScript: Ensures type safety and code maintainability.
Backend:

Node.js & Express.js: Powers our server, handling API requests, authentication, and transaction management.
Ethers.js: Facilitates interaction with the Ethereum blockchain.
Anchor (Solana) & @solana/web3.js: Supports Solana blockchain operations.
1Inch Swap API: Ensures optimal token swap rates by aggregating multiple DEXs.
Websockets: Enables real-time client-server communication.


Hacky things: 1Inch is usable to operate only on Mainnet for our purpose, so we are already supporting Mainnet
